audit.why: 48.55% over 587 games with diff TRICKY 7/10 is consistent: you win the lane phase, she takes over at 6 and in grouped fights.
audit.corrected: Lane favours you levels 1-5 and at first item; Pop Blossom at 6 and grouped late fights are hers.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and whys[5] carry the wrong stage labels (both read as Levels 4-5 / Level 6 against rows that are Level 6 and First item), and whys[6] merges two stages.
audit.why: Row 4 is Level 6 — the stage where Pop Blossom (120/105/90s) comes online and its wind-up is hidden while she is disguised. Row 5 is First item. Row 6 is 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = hidden Pop Blossom wind-up; First item = swing-autos plus Comeuppance on her reveal; 2+ items = grouped Pop Blossom.

audit.whatIsWrong: The root is repeatedly attributed to Blooming Burst. Blooming Burst is her Q (damage only); the root is Tangle-Barbs (E). Text also says to sidestep the root 'behind minions', which is backwards, and calls Akshan's Heroic Swing a dash.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs becomes larger, faster and roots for longer if it kills a unit or passes through a champion — hiding in a dying wave upgrades it. Neeko's disguise (Inherent Glamour) breaks when she takes immobilizing CC, casts a damaging spell, or the disguise takes damage equal to its health bar, so your Q can strip a suspicious minion. Pop Blossom's preparation is hidden while she is disguised — the tell you normally get does not exist.
audit.corrected: Sidestep Tangle-Barbs (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) wide and away from dying minions, never behind them — a kill upgrades its size, speed and root duration. Q a suspicious minion to break the disguise, and treat a disguised Neeko at 6 as a Pop Blossom with no wind-up tell.

audit.why: Tangle-Barbs at 12s rank 1 is the punishable cooldown; step-ups belong in that window.
audit.corrected: Step up in the 12 seconds after a missed Tangle-Barbs.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet flagged 'Blooming Bursts' in spikes[3] as a near-miss name.
audit.why: It is not a near-miss of the right ability — Blooming Burst exists but is the wrong slot for what the sentence describes. The grouped threat is Pop Blossom (R).
